seats.notes: …Night, Prey Upon), fliers and reach (Somberwald Spider, Orchard Spirit, Geistcatcher's Rig for fliers), and Spider Spawning as the stall-breaker. Cut the off-colour white and red cards, plus the weaker filler like Rotting Fensnake and extra Grimace; 10 Forest and 7 Swamp follow the green pip count.

…colour: efficient creatures (Ghoulraisers, Walking Corpses, Stromkirk Patrols), Bloodline Keeper as the bomb, and Into the Maw, Blazing Torch and Pitchburn Devils for removal and reach. Cut Traitorous Blood, Gruesome Deformity, Ancient Grudge and the extra Grotto to keep the curve and mana clean.

Red-white is the deepest pairing in this pool: 11 red playables including Brimstone Volley x2, Harvest Pyre x2 and Pitchburn Devils, plus white fliers and removal-adjacent cards. I cut Curse of Stalked Prey to reach 23 spells, with 17 lands split 9 Mountain and 8 Plains for the red-heavy pips.
White-blue fliers and removal (Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, Rebuke, Slayer) with cheap creatures as filler. 23 spells plus Moorland Haunt and 16 basics make 17 lands.

…green core, ground creatures plus flying Vampire Interloper, Orchard Spirit (evasion), Somberwald Spider and Morkrut Banshee, backed by Tribute to Hunger, Corpse Lunge and Spidery Grasp. Cut Ranger's Guile, Maw of the Mire and the Wooden Stakes; 9 Forest and 8 Swamp to match the green-heavy pips.

Two-colour W/B creature deck: white's efficient bodies and Rally the Peasants, black's removal (Victim of Night, Corpse Lunge, Curse of Death's Hold) and Night Terrors. Left out blue, green and the weaker sorceries, and cut Skeletal Grimace to fit 23 spells with 17 lands.

…including Chapel Geist, Voiceless Spirit, Stitched Drake, Murder of Crows and Smite/Claustrophobia as answers. I cut the green, red and black cards, and filled to 23 with cheap creatures, Ghostly Possession, Hysterical Blindness, Mask of Avacyn and Skaab Goliath, with 9 Plains and 8 Islands.

Blue-red tempo-midrange: 15 one-drops-to-threes plus four 2-of creatures, Geistflame x2, Devil's Play, and Frightful Delusion, with the weakest card (Think Twice) cut. 17 lands split 9 Mountain and 8 Island to cover the red double-pip Crossway Vampire and the blue Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
